question: Under the same credential-free, CPU-quantized constraints as EXP-INTEL-37982024058, does supplying the task goal and the action schema in the system prompt (removing the underspecification identified by audit VF-01, in the style of the grandparent harness min_webagent.py) convert M-7B-QWEN's or M-3B-QWEN's step-0 reveal-click into a full click-then-answer completion of the minimal Web-agent task; and if it does not, what is the demonstrable capability ceiling for that task across ALL credential-free endpoints and local models actually available to the factory (local 0.5B/3B/7B GGUFs, anonymous proxy), as bounded by a time-boxed external check of published results for comparably sized local models? The packet must return an explicit close/re-scope recommendation resolving readiness condition (3).
hypothesis: H1: At least one of M-7B-QWEN or M-3B-QWEN will clear the pre-declared capability bar (task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 over 5 seeded episodes) when the system prompt enumerates the task goal ('click the button, then answer the revealed value') and the action schema without leaking the literal answer TARGET-42, while the same candidate under the frozen underspecified prompt does not clear the bar, thereby converting the parent FALSIFIES (which audit VF-01 bounds to the underspecified prompt) into SUPPORTS at the goal/schema prompt protocol and unblocking the frozen C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark.
falsifier: H0: Even with the goal/schema-enriched prompt, neither M-7B-QWEN nor M-3B-QWEN clears the bar (under the deterministic protocol: task_success_rate < 0.6 in both models, i.e. <= 2/5 each), and the within-experiment comparator arms reproduce the parent's VF-01 failure mode (0/5 success, re-click loop, answer_action_emission_rate 0.0), confirming the failure is below the prompt ceiling. Then the demonstrable capability ceiling for the minimal Web-agent task across ALL credential-free endpoints actually available (0.5B/3B/7B local GGUFs, anonymous gpt-oss-20b proxy) is below the bar, and the bounded external check either (a) finds no published evidence that any comparably sized credential-free-local model clears an equal-or-harder multi-step Web-agent task, licensing an explicit re-scope of the four-arm benchmark off the credential-free path, or (b) points at a specific credible external result to verify in a bounded follow-up before closing.

baselines.description: M-7B-QWEN under the frozen underspecified system prompt P_comp (byte-identical to parent EXP-INTEL-37982024058), re-run in THIS experiment on the same 5 seeds (42-46) through the same harness for direct within-experiment comparison. Parent result (audit PASS): task_success_rate=0.0 (0/5), parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0, answer_action_emission_rate=0.0.
baselines.expected_outcome: Replicating the parent: task_success_rate=0.0, answer_action_emission_rate=0.0, parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0. Deviation from the parent result is itself a validity signal (harness/provisioning drift) and must be flagged.

baselines.expected_outcome: Replicating the parent: task_success_rate=0.0, answer_action_emission_rate=0.0, parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0. Deviation flagged as validity signal.

baselines.description: Uniform random action selection from the frozen 5-action valid space (click #reveal-btn, answer TARGET-41/42/43/unknown), 5 episodes, seeded RNG random.Random(42) reused across episodes, run against the SAME served task page through the SAME run_episode scorer as the candidates (via the new controls driver, prereg section 6.4). NOTE: the parent measured this control on an un-navigated about:blank page (its null-random mode never calls page.goto to the served port), which made click_ok=false and task_success structurally 0; this experiment repairs that control-sensitivity defect.
baselines.expected_outcome: parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (valid JSON by construction); task_success_rate below the 0.6 bar. A-priori i.i.d. per-episode success probability p = 156/3125 = 0.04992 (click at step 0, then answer TARGET-42 before any non-42 answer within 5 steps), so P(task_success_rate >= 0.6 i.e. >= 3/5) ~= 1.15e-3; a cheap static (no-model) simulation of the frozen seeded action sequence also yields 1/5 = 0.2 (prereg section 6.4). The 3/5 bar is unreachable by the frozen random baseline (control-sensitivity anchor).

positive_control.description: Two positive controls with stable IDs, both executed on the SAME served task page and through the SAME run_episode scorer used for candidates. (1) PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING (gate; ID inherited from parent): 10 constrained-decoding probes per model per prompt condition with probe 'Emit exactly: {"action":"click","selector":"#test"}'; verifies the GBNF decoder + strict parser produce schema-valid JSON under the prompt condition actually used for that arm. (2) PC-ORACLE-EPISODE (NEW; scorer-path canary): 5 scripted episodes in which a fixed oracle producer emits click #reveal-btn then answer TARGET-42, executed through the SAME episode scorer (run_episode in the frozen parent harness) that scores candidate episodes; proves the full success path (click -> reveal detected -> answer registered -> task_success=true) can fire under the exact implementation that will score the experiment.
positive_control.success_criterion: PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING: 10/10 schema-valid JSON per model per prompt condition. PC-ORACLE-EPISODE: 5/5 task_success=true with revealed_value=TARGET-42 in all 5 scripted episodes.
positive_control.failure_mode_policy: PC-JSON failure for a candidate under the treatment prompt -> that candidate is excluded from treatment evaluation (decoding_infrastructure_failure), never a capability verdict. PC-ORACLE < 5/5 -> scoring pipeline broken; OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID regardless of candidate results, because the scorer cannot register success.

null_control.description: 5 episodes with fixed non-JSON content ('I will click the button') driven through the same run_episode scorer against the SAME served task page (via the new controls driver, prereg section 6.3); verifies the verification logic rejects non-parseable actions and that the authoring cannot accidentally award success.

measurement_validity: Same minimal Web-agent task as parent (click #reveal-btn then answer the revealed value TARGET-42 on the identical synthetic page) for direct comparability across EXP-INTEL-37973264582, EXP-INTEL-37982024058 and this experiment.

Same harness code as the audited parent: research/intel/run_exp_37982024058.py is REUSED UNMODIFIED for all model-backed measurement (its sha256 is bound in freeze_artifacts). All prompts, the user template, task page, GBNF grammar, sampling and thresholds are config-driven; EXECUTE only transcribes per-condition harness_config.json files whose content is fully determined by the frozen strings in this packet (prereg sections 4-5) and the frozen parent fixture.

CONTROL-SENSITIVITY REPAIR (new in this experiment): the parent's null-random mode scored NC and B-RANDOM on an un-navigated about:blank page because run_episode reloads page.url and the mode never navigated to the served port. This experiment runs NC/B-RANDOM/PC-ORACLE through a new, fully specified controls driver that navigates to the served task page; the driver source is frozen verbatim in prereg Appendix A.

Identical strict parsing rule: the full completion must be valid JSON matching the schema ({"action":"click","selector":"..."} or {"action":"answer","text":"..."}); any parse error, schema violation or missing required field is a parse failure.
Identical mechanical verification: Playwright drives system Chrome; success = clicked_reveal AND revealed_value==TARGET-42 AND final_answer==TARGET-42, with terminal page-state re-verification.
Constrained JSON decoding (GBNF) enforced for ALL candidate-model arms (treatment and comparator) to isolate model reasoning from formatting failures.

Same environment and serving stack as parent: llama-cpp-python 0.2.90, chat_format=qwen, n_ctx=2048, temperature=0.0, max_tokens=512, seeds 42+episode_idx (episode seeds 42-46), CPU-only nproc=4, no GPU.

Candidate model set frozen: M-7B-QWEN (primary) then M-3B-QWEN (fallback); same model family/quantization as parent (Qwen2.5 Q4_K_M), artifacts sha256-pinned from parent provisioning evidence; no post-freeze model additions and no census beyond the two local candidates plus carried references.

Each evaluated model is measured under BOTH prompt conditions (treatment and comparator) on identical seeds, producing a complete within-experiment 2x2 (model x prompt) evidence matrix; the paired comparator is collected for every candidate that reaches task evaluation, in both the positive and negative branches, so the prompt is identified as the driver within this packet.

New diagnostic metric answer_action_emission_rate (fraction of episodes where at least one valid answer action is emitted) added to the parent stable metric set; it directly measures the VF-01 re-click-loop transition.

Raw evidence preserved per condition: model receipts (download URL, sha256, bytes, load time), per-episode raw completions, parsed actions, click_ok, reveal detection, final answer, step counts, latency, completion tokens, prompt_condition tag.

Bounded external capability check (prereg section 8) is time-boxed (<= 30 min) and INFORMATIONAL: it records a structured capability envelope and feeds the pre-declared close/re-scope recommendation; it never overrides the local measurement outcome.

Deterministic protocol (temperature=0.0, fixed seeds): outcomes must be read as a deterministic-protocol result with zero within-cell variance, consistent with parent audit VF-03; the 3/5 bar is a pre-declared operational adequacy rule, not a significance test (see control_sensitivity evidence).
decision_rule: OUTCOME is exactly one of {SUPPORTS, FALSIFIES, MEASUREMENT_INVALID}. Candidates in order: M-7B-QWEN then M-3B-QWEN. P_treat = goal/schema prompt (prereg 4.1); P_comp = frozen underspecified prompt (prereg 4.2). PREFLIGHT (before any model inference): run the controls driver (PC-ORACLE-EPISODE, NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION, B-RANDOM-ACTION) against the served task page. If PC-ORACLE-EPISODE < 5/5 -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (scorer cannot register success). If NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION parseable_action_rate_step1 != 0.0 or task_success_rate != 0.0 -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (verification logic broken). If B-RANDOM-ACTION task_success_rate >= 0.6 -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (the task/bar is not discriminating; a chance policy would clear it). PROVISIONING (before a candidate is evaluated): GGUFs are located or (re-)downloaded via the confirmed huggingface.co resolve-redirect route and sha256-verified against the parent-pinned digests (prereg 3.1); any unresolved digest mismatch or download failure is a provisioning_failure for that candidate -> record deviation, continue with the remaining candidate; if BOTH candidates are unprovisionable -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID. PHASE A (per candidate M_i): A1 run PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING under P_treat; if pass_rate < 1.0 -> EXCLUDE M_i from treatment evaluation (decoding_infrastructure_failure), go to next candidate. A2 else run 5 task episodes under P_treat (seeds 42-46), yielding T(m) = task_success_rate and P1(m) = parseable_action_rate_step1. A3 run 5 task episodes under P_comp (seeds 42-46) for the SAME candidate, yielding C(m) = comparator task_success_rate (plus reference PC-JSON under P_comp). A4 if T(m) >= 0.6 AND P1(m) >= 0.6 -> OUTCOME=SUPPORTS, Status=COMPLETE, STOP (no further candidates). A5 if T(m) >= 0.6 AND P1(m) >= 0.6 is false, continue to the next candidate. PHASE B (after both candidates are exhausted or excluded, at least one was evaluated on task, none cleared): B1 run the bounded external capability check (informational, prereg 8). B2 OUTCOME=FALSIFIES, Status=COMPLETE. MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reached only when: (i) every candidate was excluded at PC (decoding_infrastructure_failure), or (ii) a PREFLIGHT control fails (oracle < 5/5, NC not null, B-RANDOM clears the bar), or (iii) both candidates unprovisionable. The external envelope never changes OUTCOME; it is recorded in metrics.external_capability_envelope and, per prereg 8.3, maps to the close/re-scope recommendation.
product_consequence_positive: SUPPORTS: readiness condition (3) is satisfied by a proven same-model driver. Gate 2 of the frozen C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark converts from FAIL to PASS at the goal/schema prompt protocol; Intel hands off the verified credential-free endpoint (model + exact prompt + harness config) so Product/Graph can run the frozen four-arm benchmark (COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER, same model/tools/budget) as specified. Audit VF-01 is retired with evidence: the underspecification was the actionable driver. C-LLM-INHERIT advances from HYPOTHESIS toward EXPERIMENTAL/VALIDATED; C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY and C-PRODUCT-ECON regain an executable benchmark substrate.
product_consequence_negative: FALSIFIES: the credential-free 3B-8B GGUF path is exhausted under factory constraints (CPU-only, huggingface.co resolve-redirect only, llama.cpp 0.2.90) even with a goal/schema prompt; the parent's DESIGN_COMPROMISED boundary is confirmed protocol-stable, and U-01/U-02 in the parent audit are closed (the deficit is below the prompt ceiling). Deliverable: an explicit close/re-scope recommendation to the Global Research Director (per prereg 8.3 and decision rule): either a bounded follow-up on a specific external model flagged by the envelope, or the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark is re-scoped off the credential-free path (drop Gate 3 same-model external anchor; internally re-run comparators with retrieval-quality metrics on a dynamic-range task bank where cold/retrieval arms are not at ceiling, per the B2 precedent). C-LLM-INHERIT stays HYPOTHESIS until the re-scoped design is approved.
estimated_cost: ~45-120 min wall time total, CPU-only. Downloads: ~4.7 GB (7B split shards) + ~2.1 GB (3B), (re-)downloaded via huggingface.co resolve-redirect only if matching-digest files are absent on the EXECUTE runner; bandwidth ~0-6.8 GB. Inference (parent-measured 5.1 s/call 7B, 2.2 s/call 3B): worst case full 2x2 matrix = 2 models x 2 prompts x (10 PC probes + 5 episode steps-bounded traces) ~= 100 calls; 7B arm ~50 calls (~4.5 min) + 3B arm ~50 calls (~2 min) + 2 model loads (~2-3 min) + playwright episodes (~1-3 min; failed clicks on a hidden button cost up to 8 s each). Controls via the controls driver: oracle 5 + NC 5 + B-RANDOM 5 scripted episodes (< 30 s). External capability check: <= 30 min bounded search (websearch + archived leaderboards). No GPU, no paid API.
expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing in both directions (Director mandate: 'either satisfied by a proven same-model driver or the four-arm benchmark re-scoped off the credential-free path'). This is the single unresolved measurement named by parent audit U-01/U-02 and mandate blocker B3: it separates a prompt/underspecification artifact (would unblock the flagship four-arm benchmark at zero new infrastructure cost) from a model-capability ceiling (closes the credential-free path and triggers an explicit, accountable re-scope), and it inventories the demonstrable ceiling across ALL endpoints/models actually available (0.5B/3B/7B GGUFs + proxy + bounded external envelope). The within-experiment 2x2 also re-verifies the parent's comparator outcomes for harness-drift detection, and the repaired controls remove a control-sensitivity defect found in the parent packet. Low cost (<= 2 h, CPU-only) relative to the decision at stake; the bounded external check prevents an infinite model census (mandate prior B2/B3 anti-pattern).

decision_rule_reachability.reason: The decision rule is a 3-outcome FSM (SUPPORTS / FALSIFIES / MEASUREMENT_INVALID) with no unreachable branch. SUPPORTS is reachable: PC-ORACLE-EPISODE proves the scorer registers success, the treatment differs from the parent-failing cell only in the VF-01-identified instruction/schema dimension, and the candidate cells are open in both directions. FALSIFIES is reachable: the parent already exhibits the full comparator failure mode (0/5, re-click loop) and the treatment may not fix it. MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via explicitly enumerated preflight/provisioning conditions. Thresholds are arithmetically attainable: 3/5 = 0.6 exactly at k=3; the bar is NOT at ceiling or floor (parent comparator 0/5; oracle canary 5/5; candidate cells open). Precedence is a strict chain (preflight -> provisioning -> A1 -> A2 -> A3 -> A4 early-stop -> B), so no later branch shadows an earlier one. The comparator is collected inside Phase A (A3) for every evaluated candidate, in both branches, so no comparator branch depends on a future-stage value. The external check is explicitly non-gating, so it cannot create an ambiguous or unreachable branch.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Every hard prerequisite is either verified-available by the accepted audit-PASS parent packet (which executed the identical stack on the same ubuntu-latest runner image and workflow) or explicitly carries a frozen failure path. (1) Models: huggingface.co resolve-redirect route confirmed (302 -> us.aws.cdn.hf.co); exact artifacts sha256-pinned in parent raw evidence (7B shards dfce12e3.../539cf93f..., 3B 626b4a66...); matching-digest files staged at /tmp/opencode/gguf/ may be reused if present on the EXECUTE runner, otherwise re-downloaded via the same route and sha256-verified BEFORE load; digest mismatch or download failure -> recorded provisioning_failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID branch, never silent substitution. Models are remote content identified by frozen URL + pinned sha256 (packet-contract-compliant; the content is deterministic, so no sampling protocol is needed). (2) Libraries: llama-cpp-python 0.2.90 and playwright 1.63.0 are pip-installed at EXECUTE (exact commands in prereg 3.2); the parent installed and used both successfully on the identical image. (3) Browser: system Chrome at /usr/bin/google-chrome, present on the ubuntu-latest image and parent-verified headless with --no-sandbox (Chrome 154.0.8037.97). (4) CPU-only nproc=4, ~14 GB RAM and disk for ~6.8 GB of weights (7B Q4_K_M fits; parent ran identically). (5) Harness code: reuses the audited frozen parent harness (no new scoring machinery); the only new code is the fully specified controls driver whose verbatim source is frozen in prereg Appendix A. No credential, GPU, paid API, or unreachable dataset is required. Install/download failures map to a frozen MEASUREMENT_INVALID path, never to a capability verdict.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Treatment vs comparator differ in EXACTLY one variable: prompts.system content (goal/schema enumeration vs the frozen underspecified string); task page, user_template, GBNF grammar, sampling, seeds, harness and scoring are byte-identical. The comparator arms (B-UNDERSPECIFIED-PROMPT-7B/3B) are collected within THIS packet for every candidate that reaches task evaluation, so the prompt is identified as the driver locally and the parent's VF-01 failure mode is pinned. The design has a non-zero/ non-identical differentiation surface: the parent measured the comparator at task_success_rate=0.0 with step-1 parse 1.0, while the oracle canary measures 5/5 and the treatment cell is open in both directions (0/5 to 5/5). Neither arm is at a ceiling (5/5 is the max by construction and 3/5 is not a ceiling because the parent measured 0/5 on the identical task) nor at a floor (the oracle proves 5/5 is reachable; the task is mechanically completable). Carried references (B-0.5B-QWEN-LOCAL, B-POLLINATIONS-PROXY) are explicitly labeled non-re-run reference evidence for the 'ALL endpoints available' statement and cannot be confused with re-measured arms. Cost dimensions are identical between arms (same inference calls, same token budgets), so no comparator hides a cost dimension.

control_sensitivity.reason: Three controls fire under the SAME served task page and the SAME run_episode scorer that score the experiment, with pre-declared independent criteria, and a repaired defect makes them sensitive. This is the check the parent failed silently: the parent's null-random mode ran NC and B-RANDOM on an un-navigated about:blank page (run_episode reloads page.url; the mode never called page.goto to the served port), so B-RANDOM's 0/5 was structural, not chance, and the control could not detect a chance-clearing bar. This design corrects that by running all three controls through a new, fully specified driver that navigates to the served task page (prereg 6 / Appendix A). (1) PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING: 10/10 schema-valid JSON under the actual prompt condition; it isolates decoding from reasoning (parent: 10/10 for both models while the task failed 0/5, proving the control discriminates infrastructure from capability). (2) PC-ORACLE-EPISODE (NEW): a scripted click-#reveal-btn then answer-TARGET-42 producer driven through the exact run_episode scorer must register 5/5 task_success, proving the full success path (click -> reveal detection -> answer registration -> final verification) can fire; without it a latent scorer bug making task_success always False would be conflated with model failure. (3) NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION stays null (0% parseable, 0% success) under the same navigation. (4) B-RANDOM-ACTION stays at chance under the same scorer: a-priori i.i.d. per-episode success probability p = 156/3125 = 0.04992, so P(>=3/5) ~= 1.15e-3, and a cheap static (no-model) simulation of the frozen seeded sequence yields 1/5 = 0.2; the 3/5 bar is unreachable by the frozen random baseline. No control is tautological beyond the inherited decoder gate, and none is impossible (all criteria are either already observed in the parent or mechanically scripted).

treatment_liveness.reason: C-LLM-INHERIT is a Product-relevant claim, so treatment_liveness is declared PASS, not NOT_APPLICABLE. The treatment is a system-prompt string variant (goal/schema enumeration) evaluated by the audited, fully config-driven parent harness; it requires no new machinery, model, or hardware. Liveness is verified by construction: (a) the harness executed real positive-control and episode runs in the parent under the identical configuration surface, (b) EXECUTE transcribes a treatment harness_config.json whose ONLY field difference from the frozen comparator fixture is prompts.system (mechanical single-field replacement from the frozen prereg 4.1 string), and (c) PC-ORACLE-EPISODE runs at EXECUTE start and proves the scorer path can carry a click-then-answer completion to task_success=true, so a non-null executable treatment behavior is guaranteed before any candidate arm is measured. No frozen host-side code mutation is required (harness sha256 is bound in freeze_artifacts).

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: The experiment's operative pre-existing code and fixture dependencies are exactly two EXISTING frozen files, both bound by hash: (1) research/intel/run_exp_37982024058.py - the audited harness REUSED UNMODIFIED for all model-backed measurement and imported by the controls driver for run_episode/start_page_server/make_null_producer/make_random_producer; (2) research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37982024058/raw/harness_config.json - the frozen comparator fixture that is the byte-template for both per-condition configs. Everything else is either remote content pinned by frozen identifiers/hashes (GGUFs: URLs + sha256 in prereg 3.1) or EXECUTE-time materializations whose content is FULLY determined by frozen strings in this packet and cannot change interpretation: (a) two per-condition harness_config.json transcriptions (byte-identical to the bound fixture except prompts.system replaced by the verbatim prereg 4.1/4.2 strings); (b) the controls driver research/intel/run_exp_38013769440_controls.py, whose COMPLETE source is frozen verbatim in prereg Appendix A and which only imports the bound harness and calls its run_episode with the frozen producers. Each materialization is sha256-recorded in result.json artifacts and provenance for diff-checking against this packet. No task bank, dataset, or other mutable dependency exists. (freeze_experiment.py requires freeze_artifacts entries to be existing files, so the two hash-bound existing files are listed; the deterministic EXECUTE materializations are governed by the frozen prereg text instead.)
